idx_external_locators_current_issue.name: idx_external_locators_current_issue
idx_external_locators_current_issue.where: "external_entity_locators"."valid_to" IS NULL AND "external_entity_locators"."issue_number" IS NOT NULL

external_locators_issue_repository_check.name: external_locators_issue_repository_check
external_locators_issue_repository_check.value:
("external_entity_locators"."issue_number" IS NULL AND "external_entity_locators"."repository_entity_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("external_entity_locators"."issue_number" IS NOT NULL AND "external_entity_locators"."repository_entity_id" IS NOT NULL)

github_bulk_transfer_successions_audit_c.name: github_bulk_transfer_successions_audit_check
github_bulk_transfer_successions_audit_c.value:
"github_bulk_transfer_successions"."target_number" > 0
        AND length("github_bulk_transfer_successions"."actor") BETWEEN 1 AND 80
        AND length("github_bulk_transfer_successions"."reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 500
        AND length("github_bulk_transfer_successions"."idempotency_key") BETWEEN 8 AND 192

github_identity_exception_events_proof_s.name: github_identity_exception_events_proof_state_check
github_identity_exception_events_proof_s.value:
("github_identity_exception_events"."action" = 'revoke' AND "github_identity_exception_events"."proof_type" IS NULL)
      OR ("github_identity_exception_events"."action" = 'accept' AND "github_identity_exception_events"."proof_type" IS NOT NULL)

github_task_transfer_reconciliations_aud.name: github_task_transfer_reconciliations_audit_check
github_task_transfer_reconciliations_aud.value:
length("github_identity_task_transfer_reconciliations"."actor") BETWEEN 1 AND 80
        AND length("github_identity_task_transfer_reconciliations"."reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 500
        AND length("github_identity_task_transfer_reconciliations"."idempotency_key") BETWEEN 8 AND 192

github_write_outcome_events_audit_check.name: github_write_outcome_events_audit_check
github_write_outcome_events_audit_check.value:
length("github_write_outcome_events"."actor") BETWEEN 1 AND 80
      AND length("github_write_outcome_events"."reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 500
      AND length("github_write_outcome_events"."idempotency_key") BETWEEN 8 AND 192
      AND length("github_write_outcome_events"."proof_digest") = 64
